Car Carrier Services in Peshawar

Trained crew, own vehicles and a fixed price.

Exo Packers and Movers is a trusted provider of car carrier services in Peshawar. Our trained crew, own vehicles and fixed prices make car carrier simple for families, offices and businesses across Peshawar and nearby areas.

We handle cars, SUVs and light vehicles. Every job starts with a clear quote, so you know the price before we begin, and our team plans the route, vehicle and crew size around your needs.

Comprehensive Car Carrier Solutions in Peshawar

Our car carrier service in Peshawar covers the whole job: planning, wrapping, loading, transport, unloading and placing everything where you want it. Whether it is a single room or a full move, the same careful process applies.

Every item is padded or wrapped before it leaves the building, and heavy goods are strapped so they cannot slide. We bring boxes, blankets, tape and trolleys, so you do not need to arrange anything yourself.

Modern Fleet for Every Need

Our vehicles include dedicated car carrier trucks. We match the vehicle to your load, so you never pay for space you do not need and never run out of room on the day.

All vehicles are kept clean and serviced, and our drivers know the roads of Peshawar and the best routes to avoid delays.

Safe and On-Time Service

Time matters during a move. We confirm the pickup time in advance, arrive when we say we will and keep you updated until delivery. Our crew follows a simple loading plan so the first things you need are the first things off the truck.

Safety comes first. We use straps, padding and careful stacking, and our loaders are trained to handle stairs, lifts and tight spaces.

Business and Commercial Moves

Dealers, showrooms and families in Peshawar send vehicles to other cities safely on our carriers.

Shops, offices, warehouses and factories in Peshawar trust us for planned, low-downtime work. We can move at night or at weekends and label everything by area so your team can start work again quickly.
